name: Bryson Ritchie
title: Assistant Project Manager
bio:
Bryson Ritchie joined The Ritchie Group in 2021. Bryson has experience working in commercial construction management, multifamily acquisitions, and multifamily development. His primary responsibilities at The Ritchie Group include project management for multifamily and mixed-use developments.

Bryson received a Bachelor of Science degree in Construction Management with a Minor in Management from Brigham Young University (2022). In 2025, Bryson completed the Master of Real Estate Development (MRED) program at the David Eccles School of Business at the University of Utah. In his free time, Bryson enjoys skiing, hiking, following sports, and being outdoors.
